Elena (AE): heads-up — SparkBridge POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Need to lock acceptance gates today: latency targets, cost ceiling, quality evals, and the security checklist. Can SE/ML/Sec confirm feasibility?
Jasper (SE): quick take — latency: p95 <= 180ms for chat/generation seems doable on hosted with a 13B int8 model and small batch sizes. Embeddings p95 <= 80ms. Need concurrency profile to confirm.
Maya (ML Eng): for quality we want a reproducible eval: 1k prompt set (mix of retrieval, QA, dialog), golden responses, and an automated metric + manual review. Pass if: semantic-sim >= 0.85 (avg) AND hallucinations < 3% on sample.
Priya (Security): they asked for KMS and data residency. For hosted trial we can offer customer-encrypted keys (bring-your-own-kms) + SOC2 docs. If they insist on VPC/KMS we'll need Private deployment + legal signoff. Also request: data retention TTL and logging controls.
Ravi (SRE): for a two-week POC we can schedule a small Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) if they commit to a burn estimate. Otherwise hosted with reserved throughput should work. We'll add an autoscale guard and a fallback policy to a cheaper model to avoid spikes.
Carlos (Product): add an acceptance gate for model drift: if eval score drops >5% vs baseline, rollback to previous model. Also require a smoke-run within first 24h of traffic.
Jasper (SE): cost ballpark — for 10M tokens/month (estimate they gave) hosted + medium model ≈ $1.1k/month; Dedicated would be higher but predictable. I'll share a short calc.
Jasper (SE): sample request we plan to run for perf tests:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-sync-13b-int8","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Elena (AE): timeline check — customer wants A/B eval done in 10 days, final signoff end of two-week trial. We need test harness + cost calc by EOD.
Maya (ML Eng): I'll prepare the 1k prompt set + eval script (embedding + manual sample). Will mark seed prompts and expected tolerances.
Priya (Security): I'll send them the minimal questionnaire answers and an ask for their security contact. Also confirm whether they need pen-test evidence.
Ravi (SRE): I'll provision a demo pool and a canary route. Will attach runbook links once infra is up.
Jasper (SE): Action list: 1) Cost calc (me) — EOD. 2) Eval prompts + script (Maya) — tomorrow 12pm PT. 3) Sec Qs & KMS options (Priya) — today 5pm PT. 4) Demo infra + runbook (Ravi) — by tomorrow 9am PT. 5) Rollout fallback policy (Carlos) — by tomorrow.
Elena (AE): perfect — I'll share this with SparkBridge and confirm tomorrow's kickoff invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy/ci-demo started — logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345 (will post success)
Jasper (SE): noted, I'll post the cost calc in the thread when ready.
Maya (ML Eng): also: propose acceptance sampling procedure — run full eval end of day 7 and final on day 14. If either fails, we trigger a remediation plan.
Elena (AE): OK locking this. Owners please update thread when items done.
Priya (Security): acknowledged.
Ravi (SRE): provisioning now.
Jasper (SE): cost calc posted — see attached table (internal).
